Tamannaah Bhatia's Sari Features Mithila Art for Chhath Puja Promotion

Actress Tamannaah Bhatia was seen in a sari adorned with Mithila art, featuring colors chosen for Chhath Puja. The sari's pallu was decorated with the traditional Madhubani art form, presenting a promotional look for the film 'The One'.
